information.local: Fixed reference from own/one-hop boundary returns, bootstrapped at CONTACT_READY from the existing displacement estimate. Metric SE(2) readout thereafter; no physical pose/contact truth.
information.shared: Existing all-team vector median drives the existing common phase supervisor; not fully decentralized.
information.safety: Original map, object velocity, QP, contact physics, thresholds and independent stopping/completion unchanged.
information.abstention: Initialization has no measured velocity vote; failed/missing reference matches do not send a fresh navigation vote.
information.limitations: Persistent observed centroid is not known center of mass; bootstrap bias remains; no absolute-error certificate.

evaluation.completion: Original HOLD + speed <= .005 for 40 frames AND final Euclidean error <= .12 m
evaluation.horizon: Use saved trajectory at 150 s for unended runs; completion time only for tasks already terminated successfully
evaluation.censoring: Unfinished at 600 s is right-censored; early off-target HOLD is separately reported
evaluation.safety: Original separation, clearance, penetration and QP failure checks; scaling events separately reported
evaluation.comparisons: Four methods paired within nine reused development conditions; previous vector-CVT isolates readout change. Every failure/error retained.
evaluation.gate: Mechanism may continue only if at least one original failure becomes completed without any hard safety violation in the candidate arm, reference checks pass, and logs show the mechanism was used. Report every endpoint and all regressions. No default promotion; no post-result tuning.
evaluation.error_policy: Every planned/launched case remains in denominator; errors, timeouts, regressions and budget cutoffs retained
evaluation.factorial: Per condition report Y10-Y00, Y11-Y01 for position, Y01-Y00, Y11-Y10 for velocity, and Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00 interaction. Completion, endpoint error, off-target settling and hard safety separate. No frame-based p-values or population confidence intervals.
evaluation.statistics: Paired condition-level deltas, all 9 launched episodes in denominator. Completion, hard safety, G500, off-target settling and 600 s censoring separate; no frame-level independence or population confidence interval.

mechanism.reference: Unmodified both-reference vector CVT. Not the historical scalar CVT or spacing.
mechanism.recovery: While suspended, original quorum/dwell use locally prospective geometric push eligibility instead of disabled action flags. No new contact-force assumption.
mechanism.reinforcement: Recovery plus retain useful incumbent patches (suppress tangential CVT at these patches), original pressure law, spare-first observed local-route recruitment. No donor release, no new pressure allocation.

preserved: Root environment, observed-reference fitting/admission, physical model, no attachment, all safety limits, task tolerance, settle/stop criteria and manuscript/title remain unchanged. Existing team supervisor remains explicit; not fully decentralized.
comparison_scope: One reused development seed; three preselected failures, nine new episodes, no significance or reliability claim. Reference must reproduce all 25 historical replay arrays and old step fields. No tuning or additional scientific episodes.
